subject.title: Containerized/self-hosted deploys can't use externalized channel plugins: openKeyedStore is gated to trusted plugins, with no supported way to trust a self-hosted channel

question: Should OpenClaw add a provenance-preserving immutable official plugin install root or record path for self-hosted containers whose mutable state directory is mounted?
rationale: Automation cannot choose which externally supplied plugin roots should receive trusted keyed-state and ingress APIs without maintainer security intent.

options.title: Design immutable official provenance
options.body: Add a supported official package plus install-record path outside the mutable state mount while keeping raw load paths and config trust flags untrusted.

options.title: Document current limitation
options.body: Keep the current fail-closed model and document that runtime containers must use the same state directory snapshot created by the installer.

options.title: Ship official bundled images
options.body: Avoid a general trust-root change by publishing image variants that bundle common official channel plugins under maintainer-controlled provenance.

recommendation.title: Design immutable official provenance
recommendation.body: Add a supported official package plus install-record path outside the mutable state mount while keeping raw load paths and config trust flags untrusted.

likelyOwner.reason: hxy91819 is the current assignee and has already framed the issue in terms of the intended plugin trust model.
